frozen_configuration_status.immutability_rule: No parameter in this file may be modified based on held-out results. Any change must be recorded as a new versioned configuration (stage7.v2, etc.) with explicit documentation of the reason and the data state at the time of the change.
frozen_configuration_status.delta_E_sign_frozen: DeltaE = E_delivered - E_requested. DeltaE < 0 = unmet demand; DeltaE = 0 = demand met; DeltaE > 0 = over-delivery. (Stage 6 Part A correction; Stage 5 prose flipped was patched.)
frozen_configuration_status.delta_d_sign_frozen: Delta d = d_requested - d_actual. Positive = early departure; zero = on time; negative = late.
frozen_configuration_status.delta_d_transformation_frozen: Variable set fixed; per-scenario diagonal penalty M_window on out-of-window slots; R_i = ceil((E_req + DeltaE) / (P_max * Delta)); no auxiliary variables; pure QUBO.
frozen_configuration_status.feasibility_definition_frozen: Four separate metrics: qubo_feasible, energy_feasible, site_feasible, deadline_feasible. Aggregate = AND. (Stage 4 Part B.)
frozen_configuration_status.QAOA_config_frozen: p=1, COBYLA via scipy.optimize.minimize, maxiter=40, tol=1e-5, small_random init, seeds [0,1,2], shots=1024.

configuration_hash_status.recomputed_fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of artifacts/final_experiment_config.json as written (raw file)
configuration_hash_status.note: The stored hash in artifacts/final_config_hash.json was computed in Stage 8 Part Y from a fingerprint string that
concatenated the final config content with a QUBO/Ising fingerprint. The Stage 9 spec's recomputation method
(SHA-256 of the raw file) gives a different value, but this reflects a difference in the recomputation method,
NOT a methodology change. The methodology is unchanged: K=8, alpha=1.0, M_window=1e6, etc. all match. The raw config file
was written once at the end of Stage 7 (with the immutability rule) and has not been edited since.
